headline: Agenda covers approving March 2026 hearing minutes, deliberating appeals, and other business.
summary: The posted agenda lists items for consideration, including approving the March 2026 hearing minutes and deliberating appeals. It is an agenda, not minutes, so it does not show how any item was decided.
